items.raw_excerpt: This French word is all about getting lucky, but its origins go back to the Middle Ages.
items.summary_en: Une aubaine is a French word for a lucky find or a windfall. Its roots go back to the Middle Ages.

items.title_en: French Word of the Day: Une aubaine

items.raw_excerpt: Winter arrives earlier in Norway than in most other countries, so when is the right time to change your car tyres?
items.summary_en: Winter comes earlier in Norway than in most countries. This guide explains the best time to change your car tyres. It also covers the rules drivers should follow.
items.summary_ko: 노르웨이는 대부분의 나라보다 겨울이 일찍 찾아옵니다. 이 안내는 자동차 타이어를 바꾸기 좋은 시기를 알려 줍니다. 운전자가 지켜야 할 규칙도 함께 다룹니다.
items.title_en: When should you switch to winter tyres in Norway?

items.raw_excerpt: Some people wrongly accused South West Water of intentionally discharging sewage - but it was others' fault
items.summary_en: A blocked pipe made sewage spill onto a village green in Cornwall. Some people wrongly blamed South West Water for dumping it on purpose. The blockage turned out to be someone else's fault.
items.summary_ko: 영국 콘월의 한 마을 광장에 하수관이 막혀 오수가 흘러넘쳤다. 일부 주민은 사우스웨스트워터가 일부러 버린 것이라고 잘못 생각했지만, 막힌 원인은 다른 쪽에 있었다.
items.title_en: Sewage Spills Onto a Cornish Village Green After a Pipe Blockage

items.raw_excerpt: Should Germany's citizenship test be be rewritten, made harder or simply scrapped? We asked readers, and also political parties, how they would change the 'Einbürgerungstest'.
items.summary_en: A German news outlet asked readers and political parties how they would change the citizenship test. People shared many different views on the 'Einbürgerungstest'. Some want it rewritten, some want it harder, and some want it gone.
items.summary_ko: 독일의 한 언론사가 독자와 정당들에게 시민권 시험을 어떻게 바꿀지 물었습니다. 사람들은 시민권 시험을 두고 여러 가지 의견을 내놓았습니다. 다시 쓰자는 쪽도, 더 어렵게 만들자는 쪽도, 아예 없애자는 쪽도 있었습니다.
items.title_ko: 독일 시민권 시험, 어떻게 바뀌어야 할까?
items.title_original: 'It's just weird': How readers and parties think Germany's citizenship test should change

items.raw_excerpt: French student protests on Tuesday will include a large scale demo in Paris - here's the route of the march, and the road and Metro station closures.
items.summary_en: High school students in Paris will hold a large protest march on Tuesday. The route is set, and some roads and Metro stations will close for the event.

items.raw_excerpt: Even if you love living in Denmark and feel at home here, when you've moved to a different country from where you grew up, there will perhaps always be things you miss. What are those things for you?
items.summary_en: People who moved to Denmark often miss small things from home. A Danish news site asks readers what they miss that they cannot do in Denmark. Even those who feel at home may always miss something.
items.summary_ko: 덴마크로 이주한 사람들은 고향의 작은 것들을 자주 그리워한다. 한 덴마크 매체가 독자들에게 덴마크에서는 못 해서 그리운 것이 무엇인지 묻는다. 덴마크가 집처럼 편해도 늘 그리운 무언가가 있을 수 있다.
items.title_en: What do you miss about home in Denmark?

items.raw_excerpt: Renowned Kerala muralist Basanth Peringode’s works join Rashtrapati Bhavan’s permanent collection, spotlighting Kerala’s mural heritage on a national stage.
items.summary_en: Artist Basanth Peringode from Kerala paints traditional murals. His work is now part of the permanent art collection at Rashtrapati Bhavan in New Delhi. It brings Kerala's mural heritage to a national stage.
items.summary_ko: 인도 케랄라 출신 화가 바산트 페링고데가 전통 벽화를 그려 왔다. 그의 작품이 뉴델리 라슈트라파티 바반의 상설 소장품이 되었다. 케랄라의 벽화 전통이 전국 무대에 알려지게 됐다.
items.title_en: Kerala artist's murals join India's presidential palace
items.title_ko: 케랄라 화가의 벽화, 인도 대통령궁에 걸리다
items.title_original: Artist Basanth Peringode takes Keralam’s murals to Rashtrapati Bhavan

items.raw_excerpt: A artista britânica Kathy Hinde vai criar uma escultura que junta som, escultura, imagem e tecnologia na aldeia das Fontes,…
items.summary_en: British artist Kathy Hinde is creating a sculpture in the village of Fontes, near Leiria. The work mixes sound, sculpture, image, and technology. It brings a modern art piece to a quiet rural place.

items.title_en: British artist Kathy Hinde builds a sound sculpture in a small Leiria village

items.raw_excerpt: The Norwegian government proposes raising the minimum age limit for electric scooters, new leaks about Norway's 2027 budget, DNB to cut 400 jobs, and more news on Tuesday.
items.summary_en: The Norwegian government wants to raise the minimum age for riding electric scooters. New leaks about Norway's 2027 budget also came out. The bank DNB plans to cut 400 jobs. These are some of Tuesday's top stories.

items.raw_excerpt: With his long-awaited move to Hawthorn finally done, Zach Merrett says he has "no preconceived ideas" as to what role he will play for Sam Mitchell's Hawks.
items.summary_en: Zach Merrett has completed his long-awaited move to the Hawthorn Hawks. He says he has no fixed idea about what role he will play under coach Sam Mitchell.

items.raw_excerpt: The food in 10 major Dutch cities has become less healthy over the past decade, according to new research by Amsterdam UMC. Health executives from the 10 cities have written to health minister Sophie Hermans urging her to speed up a promised food law that would let councils limit unhealthy outlets, Het Parool reported on Tuesday. The researchers scored 31 types of food outlet, from greengrocers to fast-food chains. The scores combined expert ratings with checks of more than 83,000...
items.summary_en: New research from Amsterdam UMC found that food in 10 major Dutch cities has become less healthy over 10 years. Health leaders from these cities asked the health minister to speed up a food law. The law would let local councils limit unhealthy food shops.
items.summary_ko: 암스테르담 UMC의 새 연구에 따르면 지난 10년 동안 네덜란드 10개 주요 도시의 음식이 더 건강에 나빠졌습니다. 이 도시들의 보건 책임자들은 보건 장관에게 음식 관련 법안을 서둘러 마련해 달라고 요청했습니다. 이 법안은 지방 의회가 건강에 나쁜 음식점 수를 제한할 수 있게 해 줍니다.
items.title_en: Unhealthy food shops fill Dutch cities, researchers say
items.title_ko: 네덜란드 도시에 건강에 나쁜 음식점이 넘친다는 연구 결과
items.title_original: Unhealthy food outlets dominate Dutch cities, say researchers

items.raw_excerpt: A year after winning the first Women's T20 World Cup for the Blind, India's players say they still lack grounds and jobs; captain Deepika T.C. awaits a house site.
items.summary_en: India's blind women cricket team won the first Women's T20 World Cup for the Blind a year ago. The players say they still have no grounds to play on and no jobs. Team captain Deepika T.C. is still waiting for a house site.
items.summary_ko: 인도 시각장애 여성 크리켓 대표팀이 1년 전 첫 여자 T20 블라인드 월드컵에서 우승했습니다. 하지만 선수들은 여전히 연습할 경기장도, 일자리도 없다고 말합니다. 주장 디피카 T.C.는 아직 집터도 배정받지 못했습니다.
items.title_en: India's blind women cricketers still wait for homes and jobs
items.title_ko: 인도 시각장애 여성 크리켓 선수들, 우승 후에도 집과 일자리 기다려
items.title_original: India’s blind women cricketers still wait for house sites and jobs a year after their World Cup win

items.raw_excerpt: This week’s Sweden in Focus Extra features an interview with writer, rapper, and Sweden's new 'reading ambassador', Gift Blessing.
items.summary_en: A new interview features Gift Blessing. He is a writer, rapper, and Sweden's new reading ambassador. He talks about how deportations made foreign writers question if they belong in Sweden.
